# RF-02 - Forum and Posts
## Goal Enable users to publish and interact with social content in the Paw Meet community.
## Scope - Publish text posts. - Publish image posts. - Comment on posts. - React to posts with likes. - Filter/search posts by topic, category, or popularity. - Moderate inappropriate posts (authorized roles only).
## Acceptance Criteria - Logged-in users can create text and image posts. - Users can comment on existing posts. - Users can like posts and likes are reflected in UI/data. - Forum supports filtering/searching by at least topic and popularity. - Unauthorized users cannot execute moderation actions.
